items.text: Acids and bases play an important part in our lives. They are extremely important in industry. Life itself depends on the complex networks of acid-base reactions taking place inside living organisms. To understand life, and death, we need to understand acids and bases and the reactions they undergo. In this topic we will build on the knowledge you have already gained on the properties of acids and bases. In particular, we will look at their properties quantitatively using the concept of equilibrium constants. We will also see how the strengthsofacids arerelatedto theirmolecular structures.
